style: A gentle flat vector illustration for a beginner-friendly marketing glossary. Soft, friendly, simple shapes with rounded corners and no outlines or very thin outlines. Limited palette: deep indigo (#2b3a67) as the main color, warm off-white unbleached cotton (kinari, #f6f0e4) as the plain background, light indigo tints, and a small accent of vermilion (#d9502f) used sparingly. Plain solid light background with generous empty space around the subject, centered composition, 3:2 landscape. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no captions, no logos, no brand marks, no real company or app user interfaces, no real people or celebrities, no flags. People, if any, are simple faceless or minimal-face generic figures. No photorealism, no gradients-heavy 3D, no shadows except very soft flat ones.

terms.persona: One friendly generic person standing in a spotlight circle, holding a smartphone, with small floating icons around them representing their hobbies and daily life (a coffee cup, a small plant, a clock showing evening), suggesting one imagined typical customer.
terms.conversion: A person on a path stepping through an open door into a cozy small shop, a shopping bag and a calendar check icon floating nearby, showing someone moving from looking to taking action.
terms.kgi: A small mountain with a flag on its summit, a winding path leading up to it, the flag in vermilion, representing the final goal.
terms.milestone: A winding mountain path seen from the side, with three small flags planted at equal steps along the way up to a larger flag at the summit; the three small flags in indigo, the summit flag in vermilion, representing checkpoints on the way to the final goal.
terms.kpi: A winding path up a gentle hill with several small milestone markers along the way, each marker a simple post with a check, and a flag far away at the top.
terms.impression: A smartphone screen showing a scrolling feed of simple blank card shapes, with several small eye icons floating above it, representing a post being seen many times.
terms.awareness: A small shop on a street with a soft lightbulb glowing above it, and a few passersby turning their heads toward it, representing people first noticing something.
terms.contentPillar: Three or four sturdy pillars supporting a simple roof, each pillar decorated with a different simple icon (a camera, a heart, a wrench, a star), representing recurring post themes.
terms.hashtag: A large friendly hash symbol shape made of rounded bars acting as a signpost at a crossroads, with small figures walking toward it, representing a way to be found by people interested in a topic. The symbol is a shape, not text.
terms.toneAndManner: A speech bubble wearing a small bow tie next to a palette of a few color swatches and a smiling face icon, representing a consistent voice and mood.
terms.roadmap: A folded paper map with a dotted route connecting several small round checkpoints toward a flag, a small compass beside it.
terms.proAccount: A smartphone with a small briefcase badge and a simple bar chart icon floating beside it, representing a business account with insights.
terms.facebookPage: A simple storefront drawn inside a large browser-like card frame (no real UI), with a small awning and a sign shape without text, representing a public page for a shop.
terms.newsletter: An envelope with a small sheet of paper peeking out, flying toward a cozy mailbox, with small hearts trailing behind it.
terms.ownedAudience: A small round garden fenced with a low friendly fence, with a few people sitting inside reading letters, representing readers you can reach directly.
terms.payPerUse: A smartphone with a small send arrow, and a few coins dropping into a small jar beside it, representing a small cost charged for each post.
terms.buildInPublic: A workshop table seen through a large open window, with tools, a half-made ceramic mug and a laptop, while a few small figures outside watch and cheer, representing sharing the making process openly.
terms.storeListing: A smartphone showing a simple app-icon-like rounded square and a download arrow, with a few star shapes floating nearby (no real store UI).
terms.shortLink: A long wavy ribbon being folded into a short neat loop like a paperclip chain, with a small counter dial beside it, representing a short tracked link.
terms.correlation: Two small line paths moving up and down together side by side across a plain background, with a magnifying glass looking at them.
terms.campaignLink: A chain link with a small paper tag attached to it, the tag colored vermilion, representing a link marked with where visitors came from.
terms.dns: A cute address book open on a table, with lines connecting entries to small houses on a tiny map, representing a directory that maps names to places.
terms.cname: Two small signposts, one pointing to the other with a curved arrow, both pointing toward the same little house, representing an alias name.
terms.subdomain: A large house with a small annex room attached to its side, both under the same roof color, representing a sub-address of the same domain.
terms.marketingFunnel: A large funnel shape divided into five horizontal bands from wide at top to narrow at bottom, with small figures entering at the top and fewer figures coming out at the bottom, colored in indigo tints with a vermilion accent at the bottom.
terms.tripleMedia: Three overlapping soft circles in different tints of indigo, light teal and warm vermilion, each containing a simple icon: a small house, a speech bubble with a heart, and a coin.
terms.ownedMedia: A small cozy house with a mailbox and a little garden, the house representing your own place to publish, with a small megaphone on the porch.
terms.earnedMedia: Several small speech bubbles with hearts and stars rising from a group of friendly people chatting, representing word of mouth.
terms.paidMedia: A small billboard frame on a post (with no text), with a coin and a spotlight shining on it, representing paid advertising.
terms.ugc: A customer taking a photo of a loaf of bread with a smartphone at a cafe table, with small hearts floating up from the phone, representing customers posting about a product.
terms.organicVsAds: A small seedling growing step by step into a young tree on one side, and a bright spotlight that is switched on over a stage on the other side, contrasting slow natural growth with paid reach.
terms.seoVsSns: Two paths: on one side a person holding a large magnifying glass walking toward a house, on the other side a person scrolling a smartphone while small cards float toward them like a stream.
terms.snsTraits: Seven small rounded tiles arranged in a gentle arc, each with a different simple abstract symbol (a short speech bubble, a camera, a thread spool, a group of people, a music note, a play button, a notebook), none of them real logos.
terms.concept: A simple round target board in the center, with three small friendly icons connected to it by gentle curved lines: a person silhouette, a small rain cloud, and a key, representing who it is for, what worries them, and how it is solved, joined into one clear idea.
terms.story: An open picture book whose pages show a winding path from a small sprout to a blooming flower, with a friendly person walking along the path, and two other people beside the book placing a hand on their chest warmly, representing a personal story that others relate to.
